rules.name: invoice-credit-block
rules.description: Ensures invoices are not issued to customers with active credit blocks.
rules.fetch: Retrieve billing documents from VBRK/VBRP joined to customer master KNA1 and sales area data KNVV via customer number.
rules.check:
Mark any record where:
Invoice exists (VBRK.VBELN is not blank)
AND customer has central billing block (KNA1.FAKSD is not blank) OR sales-area billing block (KNVV.FAKSD is not blank)
rules.return: Invoices issued to customers with active credit blocks, indicating bypassed credit controls requiring immediate review.

rules.name: payment-terms-favorable
rules.description: Validates that customers do not have payment terms more favorable than the master data standard.
rules.fetch: Retrieve customer payment terms (KNB1.ZTERM) for all active customers not flagged for deletion in KNA1 or KNB1.
rules.check: Mark any record where: KNB1.ZTERM indicates more favorable payment terms than the organization's defined master data standard
rules.return: Records where customer payment terms exceed standard thresholds, indicating unauthorized favorable terms requiring review and correction.
